name: pro-ai-sdlc
description: The AI-native SDLC as one stack-agnostic plugin. Stage commands: /pro-ai-sdlc:intent (interview an idea or bug into intent/<id>-<slug>/intent.md, or intent/<date>-<slug>/ in a repo with no shortcode), /pro-ai-sdlc:spec, /pro-ai-sdlc:plan, /pro-ai-sdlc:execute (build an approved plan in its own worktree and open the PR, never merge), /pro-ai-sdlc:adr (record a decision with no change behind it), /pro-ai-sdlc:review (REVIEW.md's bug, security and compliance passes), /pro-ai-sdlc:pr-babysit (loop a PR to green, never merge); repo setup for the loop moved to /pro-core:pro-dev install in pro-core. The templates the commands read ship as files under templates/ (intent, spec, plan, adr, REVIEW) so other tools can read them. Subagents: researcher (haiku), verifier (sonnet), simplifier (sonnet) and reviewer (opus). Four hooks ship in warn mode behind the mode files: protect-tests (no test edits in fix mode), plan-sync (a Stop hook that flags code changed with no plan.md update), production-gate (flags push to main, deploys, publishes and merges) and change-id (flags a commit on a change-id branch whose subject does not start with the id). /pro-ai-sdlc:execute pauses before steps that touch auth, migrations, payments, deploys or secrets unless the plan's Risks names them; every plan cites references/definition-of-done.md. A doubt-driven-development skill sends a hard-to-undo build step to a fresh-context reviewer before the next step, with an optional Codex second opinion. /pro-ai-sdlc:incident turns a production incident into an incident record and a new intent; /pro-ai-sdlc:review proposes an agent-file line when a class of finding repeats.
